## 🔍 Quick Reference

### Tag Hierarchy
- `work/*` - Work-related tasks and projects
- `tech/*` - Technical notes and patterns
- `daily/*` - Daily logs and session summaries
- `learning/*` - Educational content and research
- `health/*` - Personal health and wellness

### Status Values
- `completed` - Done and verified
- `in-progress` - Currently working on
- `blocked` - Waiting on external dependency
- `pending` - Not started, queued

### Priority Levels
- `high` - Do ASAP (critical or time-sensitive)
- `medium` - Standard priority, plan soon
- `low` - Nice to have, when time permits
